errors.message: `Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B` is not supported yet in `transformers==4.57.6`. Transformers AutoConfig does not recognize model_type `qwen3_asr`.
errors.root_cause: Unsloth FastModel.from_pretrained uses the standard Transformers AutoConfig path. The installed Transformers version used by qwen-asr does not include a qwen3_asr AutoConfig mapping, so Unsloth cannot load the ASR architecture directly.

notes: Unsloth remains suitable for ordinary Qwen3/Qwen3 MoE LLM fine-tuning, but this project uses Qwen3-ASR audio architecture.
Do not continue dependency pinning to force Unsloth in the current MVP.
Next training backend is Transformers + PEFT using the verified audio_tower target regex.
